Comedy.title: Madagascar
Comedy.description: Four zoo animals unexpectedly find themselves stranded on a wild island, where hilarious adventures, unlikely friendships, and surprising discoveries change their lives forever together.

Comedy.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
Comedy.description: The lovable animal friends continue their exciting journey as they arrive in Africa, facing new adventures, family discoveries, and unforgettable moments that strengthen their remarkable bond.

Comedy.title: Monsters, Inc.
Comedy.description: Two friendly monsters discover an unexpected friendship with a human child, leading to heartwarming adventures that challenge everything they believe about fear, courage, and kindness.

Comedy.title: Monsters University
Comedy.description: Before becoming legendary scare partners, two ambitious monsters navigate college life, fierce competition, and unexpected teamwork while learning the true meaning of friendship and success.

Comedy.title: Kung Fu Panda
Comedy.description: An enthusiastic panda is unexpectedly chosen to become a legendary warrior, beginning an unforgettable adventure filled with courage, determination, friendship, and incredible martial arts battles.

Comedy.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
Comedy.description: Po continues his heroic journey as a dangerous new enemy threatens the valley, forcing him to uncover hidden truths while protecting everyone he cares about with courage.

Comedy.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
Comedy.description: Po discovers a long-lost family while preparing to face an unstoppable villain, balancing responsibility, friendship, and courage in a spectacular adventure full of heart and humor.

Comedy.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
Comedy.description: A fresh adventure begins as Po embraces new responsibilities and faces powerful enemies, discovering that true leadership comes from wisdom, trust, and believing in others around him.

Comedy.title: Shrek
Comedy.description: A grumpy but lovable ogre sets out on an unforgettable quest that leads to unlikely friendships, magical adventures, and surprising discoveries about love, acceptance, and true happiness.

Comedy.title: Shrek 2
Comedy.description: Shrek faces hilarious new challenges after meeting his wife's royal family, discovering that love, confidence, and staying true to yourself are the greatest adventures of all.

Comedy.title: Shrek the Third
Comedy.description: With the kingdom's future uncertain, Shrek embarks on another unforgettable journey where responsibility, friendship, and unexpected heroes create a hilarious and heartwarming adventure together.

Comedy.title: Shrek Forever After
Comedy.description: Shrek finds himself in a strange alternate reality where everything has changed, leading to an emotional adventure about family, love, and appreciating the life he already has.

Comedy.title: Zootopia
Comedy.description: A determined rookie rabbit police officer teams up with a clever fox to solve a mysterious case, uncovering unexpected truths while proving that anyone can achieve greatness.

Comedy.title: Zootopia 2
Comedy.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde return for another exciting investigation, facing fresh mysteries, surprising allies, and thrilling adventures that challenge their teamwork and determination once again.
